subject: Implementation handoff: initial org setup & access checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@truvault.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation handoff: initial org setup & access checklist

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our handoff checklist, I’m starting this thread to coordinate the initial org/tenant setup so your engineers can begin integration next week. Below is a minimal set of items we typically complete during the first 48–72 hours; I’ve also attached a fillable checklist and RBAC template for your team.

Ask: Could you confirm an owner for provisioning (name + email) and whether you want API keys scoped to a single shared project or per-service projects? If you prefer, Redwood can create the projects and invite your users.

Minimum items to finish in the first pass:
- Confirm provisioning owner and primary contact
- Decide project structure: single-project vs. per-service projects
- Provide list of users to invite and their roles (Admin / Developer / Read-only) using attached RBAC_template.csv
- Confirm whether API keys should be long-lived or rotated automatically via your KMS (if KMS, please share KMS ARN)
- Identify a test dataset/project for the initial smoke test

I’ll coordinate invites from the console (we’ll provision a tenant under the TruVault org). Monica will run the technical kickoff once invites are accepted.

Thanks — short replies are perfect here to move things fast.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Customer Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: SOW_TruVault_v1.pdf; RBAC_template.csv; Initial-Org-Checklist.xlsx

Thanks Karthik — quick answers below:  

- Provisioning owner: Ahmed Patel (ahmed.p@truvault.com)
- Project structure: prefer per-service projects (analytics, ingestion, portal)
- Users: will send RBAC csv by EOD; primary invites: Ahmed (admin), Priya (dev), ops@truvault (read-only)
- KMS: we use AWS KMS — will share ARN in separate secure note
- Test dataset: will create a small sample under analytics/test-smoke

We reviewed the SOW and signed; you should have DocuSign come through. Ready for Monica’s kickoff once invites are sent.

—Samira
